paite: Van ah chiamtehna thupi leh lamdangtak; numei khat ni a kizem, akhenuai a khapi sikden leh alutung a lallukhu aksi sawm-le-nih khu hong kimu hi.
heading: Numei Leh Dragon Muhna
english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

paite: Ama'n nau apai a, nauvei leh suakkhe ding natna in akapkhia hi.
english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

paite: Huan van ah chiamtehna dang khat ahong kilang a; ngai in, dragon san lianpi, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei, alutung a lallukhu sagih khu hong kilang hi.
english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

paite: Amei in van a aksite mun thum a khen mun khat akaikhia a, leitung ah apaikhia a; dragon in huai numei nau nei ding a kisa, aneih chiang a anau nek zoh tum in ama ah adingh hi.
english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

paite: Ta pasal naupang, sikchiang a nam tengteng tung a vaihawm ding anei a; atapa pen Pathian leh alaltutphah ah laktouh in a-om a,
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

paite: numei pen gamdai ah, Pathian in amah a dia amun bawlsak ah, huai ah ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmguk khoi a om ding in atai hi.
english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

paite: Huan van ah kidouna a-om a; Mikael leh a-angelte dragon toh kidou ding in akuankhia ua; dragon leh a-angelte'n leng adouthuk uhi.
heading: Van Kidouna
english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

paite: Huan azou kei ua, van ah amun himhim uh muh in a-omta kei hi.
english: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

paite: Dragon lian, gulpi tek, diabol leh Setan chih a ompa, khovel pumpi khempa leh amah nasem angelte toh van a kipan paihkhiaksuk in a-om uhi.
english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

paite: Huan van ah aw ngaihtak mai ka za hi, "Tu'n ah i Pathian hotdamna ahong tungta, thilhihtheihna leh Khrist thuneihna; i unaute hekpa, i Pathian ma a sun leh zan a amau hekpa, paihkhiaksuk a a-om ziak in.
english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

paite: Belamnou sisan ziak leh atheihpih uh thu ziak in amah tung ah avualzouta ua; sih tanpha in leng ahinna uh a-it kei uhi.
english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

paite: Huaiziak in kipak un, aw van leh nou asung a tengte, leitung leh tuipi a ding in atung uh agik; diabol in hun tomchik phet anei chih akitheih ziak in, aheh mahmah a na kiang uah ahong paisuk hi," chi in.
english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

paite: Leitung a dragon paihkhiak ahita chih akitheihtak in, huai numei nau pasal neinu agawt hi.
english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

paite: Himahleh huai numei kiang ah muvanlai thupitak kha nih piak in a-om a, gulpi mai a kipan gamdai mun a alenlut theihna ding in, huai ah hun khat sung leh hunte leh hun kimkhat sung vak in a-om hi.
english: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

paite: Gulpi in akam a kipan in tuipi bang tui luang a numei ataihmangsak theihna ding in numei nung ah asekhia hi.
english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

paite: Lei in numei apanpih a, lei in akam aka a, dragon in akam a kipan a atui siatkhiak ana valhzohsak vekta hi.
english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

paite: Numei tung ah dragon aheh mahmah a, asuan omsun, Pathian thupiak zuite leh Jesu thu theihpihte kidoupih ding in akuankhia hi.
english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

paite: Huan tuipiau ah dragon adingh hi.
